candidate.user_submission: This child is 18 months old. The child has fever. The fever has been there for 2 days. The measured temperature is 38.0°C. The child is at high risk for malaria. Malaria test was done and it is positive. There is no generalized rash. There is no obvious cause of fever seen. No identified bacterial cause was found in this assessment. The child does not have red eyes, and there is no runny nose. The child does not have stiff neck. The child is not convulsing now and has not had convulsions. The child is not lethargic or unconscious. The child is able to drink or breastfeed. The child does not vomit everything. The child does not have cough or difficulty in breathing. The child does not have diarrhoea. The child does not have ear problem. The child has not had measles within the last 3 months and there is no cough associated with measles.
